title: the perfect pair
lyrics:
[00:07.22]You ought to know that I think we're one and the same
[00:12.97]I don't think we could help it
[00:16.03]No, I don't think we could help it
[00:20.40]We don't talk much
[00:23.61]I guess 'cause nothing has changed
[00:25.94]And I'm not sure I like it
[00:29.34]And I'm so tired of fighting
[00:32.48]If I told you
[00:33.87]You'd know how to go and break my heart in two
[00:39.30]'Cause I will anyways
[00:42.50]We'd end up like always
[00:45.76]You know me
[00:46.85]You'd better show me that you can say it to my face
[00:52.32]'Cause you know we're the same
[00:55.65]There's worse things I can take
[01:06.39]I know you hate it when there's nothing to say
[01:12.15]I'm not quite sure we'd fix it
[01:15.37]I guess we're so used to it
[01:19.53]Wish I had known this from the beginning
[01:25.29]We find it hard to work out
[01:28.84]Why we have all this doubt
[01:31.62]If I told you
[01:33.04]You'd know how to go and break my heart in two
[01:38.50]'Cause I will anyways
[01:41.71]We'd end up like always
[01:45.06]You know me
[01:46.05]You'd better show me that you can say it to my face
[01:51.67]'Cause you know we're the same
[01:54.93]There's worse things I can take
